VBO:0008024.summary: The Galician standard describes a docile, affectionate hunter that searches methodically and keeps close contact with the handler. It works by airborne scent and ground trails, holds a firm point, and retrieves on land and in water. Galicia established its breed standard and studbook in 2001 as part of a recovery program.
VBO:0008024.shortDescription: A Galician pointing dog described as affectionate and methodical, working close and retrieving on land or water.

VBO:0008015.summary: Lively and tenacious in the Galician standard, the Guicho works through dense gorse and brambles in pursuit of rabbits. It searches quietly, then gives a distinctive audible alert when a fresh trail lies close to the rabbit. Also called Quisquelo, it gained a regional breed standard and studbook in 2001.
VBO:0008015.shortDescription: A lively Galician rabbit hunter that searches quietly, then gives a distinctive alert on a fresh nearby trail.
